title: The Island of Memory Will Burst...
text:
The island of memory will burst.

Life will be only an act of candor.

Prison

for the days without return.

Tomorrow

the monsters of the ship will destroy the beach

over the wind of mystery.

Tomorrow

the unknown letter will find the hands of the soul.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the future tense as a sequence of visionary ruptures.

title: Waiting for a World to Be Unearthed...
text: Waiting for a world to be unearthed by language, someone sings the place where silence is formed. Later she will verify that the sea does not exist because it shows itself furious, nor does the world. That is why each word says what it says and also more and something else.
editorial_note: The prose-poem argument is kept compact, preserving the excess of language over simple naming.

title: The Last Innocence
text:
To depart

in body and soul

to depart.


To depart

to rid oneself of gazes,

oppressive stones

sleeping in the throat.


I must depart

no more inertia beneath the sun

no more stunned blood

no more lining up to die.


I must depart


But charge on, traveler!
editorial_note: Partir is rendered as depart to keep both physical leaving and existential rupture.

title: Caroline de Gundorode
text:
The hand of the woman in love with the wind

caresses the face of the absent one.

The hallucinated woman with her "birdskin suitcase"

flees herself with a knife in memory.

She who was devoured by the mirror

enters a chest of ashes

and pacifies the beasts of oblivion.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the poem's portrait-like sequence and its charged quotations.

title: Distance
text:
My being swollen with white ships.

My being bursting with feelings.

All of me beneath the reminiscences of your eyes.

I want to destroy the itching of your eyelashes.

I want to flee the restlessness of your lips.

Why does your phantasmagoric vision round out the chalices of these hours?
editorial_note: The translation keeps the bodily unease of eyelashes and lips against the distant white ships.

title: Fear
text:
In the echo of my deaths

there is still fear.

Do you know about fear?

I know about fear when I say my name.

It is fear,

fear with a black hat

hiding rats in my blood,

or fear with dead lips

drinking my desires.

Yes. In the echo of my deaths

there is still fear.
editorial_note: The repeated fear stays blunt, allowing the images to intensify around it.

title: The Absent One
text:
I


The blood wants to sit down.

They have stolen its reason for love.

Naked absence.

I delirium myself, I pluck myself bare.

What would the world say if God

had abandoned it like this?


II


Without you

the sun falls like an abandoned dead man.


Without you

I take myself in my arms

and carry myself to life

to beg for fervor.
editorial_note: The invented reflexive force of me deliro, me desplumo is echoed with self-directed verbs in English.

title: Writing...
text:
writing

I have asked, I have lost.


in this night in this world

embraced with you,

joy of shipwreck.


I wanted to sacrifice my days and my weeks

in the ceremonies of the poem.


I have implored so much

from the bottom of the bottoms

of my writing.


Fucking and dying have no adjectives.
editorial_note: The ending keeps the original's abrupt refusal of ornament and euphemism.

title: Beneath My Dress a Field Burned with Joyful Flowers...
text:
Beneath my dress a field burned with joyful flowers

like the children of midnight.

The breath of light in my bones when I write the word

earth. Word or presence followed by perfumed animals;

sad as itself, beautiful as suicide; and it flies

over me like a dynasty of suns.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the prose line's molten movement around the word earth.

title: Privilege
text:
I


I have already lost the name that called me,

its face rolls through me

like the sound of water in the night,

of water falling into water.

And it is his smile that is the last survivor,

not my memory.


II


The most beautiful one

in the night of those who leave,

oh desired one,

your not returning is endless,

you shadow until the day of days.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the doubled water sound and the austere final address to absence.
